Name: The Three Amiigos
Author: THEDEBAN
Description:
There are three equally sized farms with the exception of one farm having a shrine to the Queen Bee in it.
All exits to the farm are on the far right all paths other than the one leading to the bus stop is block by debris to make things a bit more interesting the Far right section also includes a café "BeeBell"  which has been left empty on the inside so that the players can decorate it however they like.
On the farm there are multiple green warp points used to traverse this large farm map.
On the farm there are 2 minecarts one located near the entrance of the farm and another down towards the bottom left of them map.
The Farm cave has been changed to have a swimming baths inside of it to help with the regen of stamina when clearing such a big map.
Lastly Grandpa's shrine has been given a upgrade and it's entrance is hidden behind a waterfall.

This mod replaces the standard farm, download it and put it into your mods folder

As of the moment this mod doesn't work with stardew valley expanded
it does however work with ridge side village

As of the Moment the map doesn't seem to work on android so bare that in mind.
